activity.notes: Jandamarra was a Bunuba leader who broke with the colonial police in 1894 and led an organised armed defence of Bunuba country until he was killed at Tunnel Creek on 1 April 1897. Bunuba is his representative political community; colonial Western Australia is not used as his affiliation polity.

sources.title: Jandamarra (1870–1897) — Australian Dictionary of Biography
sources.citation_text: The Australian Dictionary of Biography identifies Jandamarra as a Bunuba Aboriginal leader and documents his organised resistance from 1894 until his death on 1 April 1897.
